# GitHub Copilot instructions

The agent instructions for this project live in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at
the repository root, with topic rules in [`.agents/rules/`](../.agents/rules/).
Read them, and the lessons in [`.agents/memory/lessons.md`](../.agents/memory/lessons.md), before writing code. `AGENTS.md` is the single source of truth, shared
with Claude Code (via `CLAUDE.md`), Cursor (via `.cursor/rules/`), and Codex and
Devin (which read `AGENTS.md` directly).
